technology_name: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR TRUST BASED INTRUSION DETECTION IN A DISTRIBUTED IOT SYSTEM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Network Security Engine / Distributed IoT Protocol
problem_solved: Distributed IoT sensor topologies are susceptible to internal insider attacks and routing disruptions where malicious nodes cleanly compromise standard encryption keys.
description: A decentralized network security infrastructure executing a localized trust score computation algorithm that maps multi-parameter responder behaviors, continuously ledgering values across a secure distributed data system.
applications: Smart city decentralized infrastructure grids, secure industrial IoT monitoring meshes, military tactical communication arrays, and autonomous automotive sensor loops.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Robotics, Automation & Drones
